decriminalization.summary: Consensual same-sex sexual activity has been legal since the entry into force of the 1932 Criminal Code.

sources.label: Rozporządzenie Prezydenta RP z 11 lipca 1932 r. — Kodeks karny (Dz.U. 1932 nr 60 poz. 571)

marriage.summary: Article 18 of the Constitution defines marriage as between a man and a woman; neither same-sex marriage nor registered partnerships are legally recognized.

sources.label: Konstytucja Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z 2 kwietnia 1997 r., art. 18 (Dz.U. 1997 nr 78 poz. 483)

genderRecognition.summary: Legal gender recognition requires filing an adversarial civil lawsuit under Article 189 k.p.c. against one's parents or a court-appointed curator.

sources.label: Sąd Najwyższy, uchwała z 22 września 1995 r. (III CZP 118/95, OSNC 1996/1/7)

conversionTherapy.summary: No statutory prohibition exists banning conversion practices on minors or adults.

sources.label: Rzecznik Praw Obywatelskich — Praktyki konwersyjne w Polsce

asylum.summary: Persecution on grounds of sexual orientation or gender identity is recognized as grounds for international protection under refugee status legislation transposing EU law.

sources.label: Ustawa o udzielaniu cudzoziemcom ochrony na terytorium RP, art. 13 (Dz.U. 2003 nr 128 poz. 1175)
